source_caption_text:
Skilla Baby’s Breakfast Club interview took an unexpected turn when his prayer reminder went off in the middle of the conversation. 🙏🏽

Charlamagne immediately asked if he wanted to pause the interview and pray — and Skilla said yes. Moments later, everyone in the room stood up, joined hands, and Loren LoRosa led the group in prayer. ❤️

The powerful moment came during a conversation that touched heavily on Skilla’s faith and how his perspective on life changed after surviving a shooting in Redford Township, Michigan, in May 2025. He was shot three times while driving but survived, and has since spoken openly about how the experience brought him closer to God.

That faith is also reflected throughout his debut album, The Price of Fame, released August 21. The 22-track project features “Strength in Numbers” with gospel singer Erica Campbell, who Skilla has credited with helping him through a difficult period and introducing him to her church community.

A powerful moment of faith during an unexpected moment on live radio. 🙏🏽❤️
